title: Vectors: epoch floor rejection test cases
description: Test vectors for epoch floor rejection. AC: Test cases verify rejection of pre-epoch timestamps.
close_reason: SATISFIED: pre-floor epoch/counter rejection is vectorized in both replay files. test/vectors/replay_window.json: lower_epoch_rejected, lower_epoch_rejected_at_adjacent_boundary (exact floor boundary), below_window_floor_rejected, window_floor_edge (offset==WINDOW_SIZE rejected / WINDOW_SIZE-1 accepted), epoch_persistence_across_restarts and epoch_recovery_after_flash_failure pinning the persisted epoch floor across reboots; test/vectors/epoch_rollover.json adds replay_lower_epoch, replay_cross_epoch_boundary, tuple_ordering_epoch_0_seqnum_0. Consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py (parametrized receiver-state vectors + persistence oracle tests) AND rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs::test_replay_window_vectors and ::test_epoch_rollover_vectors driving the real ReplayProtector incl. persisted-state paths. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k replay_window -q => 25 passed; -k epoch_rollover -q => 22 passed; cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-link --features 'schnorr,std' --test shared_vectors => 6 passed.
